rationale: The Court is likely to reverse unanimously on a narrow First Amendment anti-entanglement/church-autonomy rationale: Wisconsin may apply neutral, objective indicia of religious purpose (e.g., church control and governance) but may not deny the exemption based on qualitative judgments that a ministry is insufficiently devotional or proselytizing. Roberts is best positioned to hold the coalition with a limited opinion, with some risk of separate concurrences (especially Thomas, and possibly Kagan/Gorsuch) to emphasize Larson-style denominational preference or to clarify administrable criteria.
